requirements.title: Prompt-bound router reactivation
requirements.description: Use the repo-local navigation Skill at natural prompt and governed output boundaries without per-tool reload.
requirements.fullText: For non-trivial governed work, activate the Framework-managed ai-workspace-router Skill on a relevant user prompt, task/context or authority change, compaction/resume/handoff uncertainty, and before final output. Reuse unchanged source context and do not reload per tool call. If invocation is not observable, state INVOCATION_UNPROVEN rather than claiming host enforcement.
